author: Arnav
problem: Letters up to 100 g cost 1.20, up to 250 g cost 2.00, up to 500 g cost 3.10 and up to 1000 g cost 4.50; anything heavier can't be posted. Return the postage for a letter of weight_g grams, or None if it can't be posted.
bug_description: Uses bisect_right instead of bisect_left, so a letter weighing exactly a tier's limit is charged at the next tier (and 1000 g can't be posted).

comments.accurate: Looks up the price tier that covers the letter's weight
comments.wrong_behavior: Each tier covers weights below its limit; a letter at the limit moves up a tier
comments.wrong_location: Tier lookup verified; prices may need rounding to cents before they're returned
